annotations.title: Gemini Deep Research Pro Multi-Hop Investigative Analyst

description: Runs an iterative, multi-hop investigative research session via Gemini Deep Research Pro, cross-examining primary sources to produce a cited technical report. Use when investigating complex scientific, architectural, or market questions requiring deep multi-hop synthesis; for running a fast single-turn Google Search grounded fact lookup, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('depth_tier' defaults to 'quick_synthesis'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (300 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

depth_tier.description: Research breadth and citation density; defaults to 'exhaustive_report' when omitted.

input.description: Investigative research question, scope, and specific aspects to analyze.

name: conduct_deep_research_investigation

output.description: Comprehensive multi-section investigative report with inline citations.

success.description: True when the research synthesis completed.

title: Gemini Deep Research Pro Multi-Hop Investigative Analyst
